title: HOW can tapping solid stone produce the exact musical scale of bells and drums? #Shorts
description:
HOW can tapping solid stone produce the exact musical scale of bells and drums?

The 56 musical pillars (*Saregama pillars*) produce distinct musical notes and percussion tones (Mridangam, Ghatam, Damaru) when struck. British colonizers cut two pillars open to check for hollow tubes or hidden bronze chimes—and found solid, dense granite throughout.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
